items.claim: CEO 重述上季營收 3.92 億美元，Q3 指引中點 5.5 億美元
items.quote: We guided for $550 million at the midpoint for Q3.
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: 每 XPU 含量從 IPO 時不到 100 美元到現在近 1,000 美元
items.quote: Now we are already at close to $1,000 of content.
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: Scorpio X 單獨一個產品線預計每 XPU 含量達 1,000 美元以上
items.quote: $1,000 or more content on a per XPU basis
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: Scorpio X 於 Q2 推出、Q3 進入量產，並出貨給額外客戶
items.quote: already entering volume production here in Q3
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: Q3 Scorpio 將成最大產品族，且 Scorpio X 超越 Scorpio P
items.quote: Scorpio will become our largest product family by revenue
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: 管理層預期多數 Scorpio X 設計導入於 2027 轉為完整 design win 放量
items.quote: full design wins to ramp in 2027
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: Scorpio P 去年前三季占總營收 15%
items.quote: it was 15% of our total revenue
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: CEO 說明 Scorpio 放量快速部分靠運氣，且公司傾向保守估計認證時間
items.quote: we do try to be conservative
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: CEO 承認競爭者將進入 Scorpio 市場，並稱非零和
items.quote: the competition will come. And we welcome that.
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: Scorpio P 在 PCIe Gen 6 出貨量最高；此前 PCIe Gen 5 交換器主導者為 Broadcom
items.quote: shipping this in the highest volume for PCI Express Gen 6
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: CFO 稱毛利率目前約中 70% 區間，長期預期往 70% 靠攏
items.quote: we do see the margins trending down towards 70%
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch

items.claim: CFO 說明毛利率受矽 vs 模組組合及 Scorpio X 貢獻影響
items.quote: Firstly would be the mix of silicon versus module content.
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch

items.claim: CFO 稱 Scorpio 毛利率與公司平均相當，視用途與 lane 配置而異
items.quote: our Scorpio margins are in line with our corporate averages
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch

items.claim: AMD MI450 初期以乙太網路承載 UALink，因 UALink 交換器尚未問世
items.quote: UALink switches are not yet available.
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: CEO 說明支援 scale-up 協定時含量大增，否則僅限 scale-out
items.quote: then our content really does explode a lot
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: CEO 表示長期目標是涵蓋完整 scale-up TAM，並已參與 NVLink Fusion
items.quote: our goal over time is to address the full scale-up TAM
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: 光學營收預計 2027 起，先從元件級（aiXscale 連接器）銷售
items.quote: revenue perspective, that will happen in 2027
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: NPO 初期營收預計 2027 下半年，2028 全年貢獻
items.quote: initial revenues in the back half of 2027
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: CEO 稱 radix 提高時每 lane ASP 反而上升
items.quote: it actually goes up with radix
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: CFO 稱已出貨給所有美國超大規模業者，並預期客戶集中度持續
items.quote: customer concentration is to be expected from here.
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch

items.claim: Scorpio X 客戶接洽數由原先 10 家增至高十幾家
items.quote: That number now today is up into the high teens
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch

items.claim: CFO 預期年底前與 2027 將有數個 Scorpio X 機會轉為 design win
items.quote: convert several of these opportunities into design wins
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch

items.claim: 客戶分散化將延續到 2027 之後，同時主要客戶也持續成長
items.quote: our lead customer will also continue to grow as well.
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch

items.claim: LEO CXL 取得 KV Cache offload 客製機會，認證中、2027 起放量
items.quote: That is in qualification now and will start to ramp in 2027.
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: NVLink Fusion 與 AWS 原生 UAL 交換器方案相比，每機架營收機會大致相當
items.quote: it's a wash.
items.speaker: CEO Jitendra Mohan

items.claim: CFO 稱資本配置聚焦有機與無機投資，並未提及回饋股東
items.quote: continue to invest both organically and inorganically
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch

items.claim: aiXscale 為小型併購例子，並持續尋找小型併購與 acqui-hire
items.quote: aiXscale was a great example of that
items.speaker: CFO Desmond Lynch
